title: Jazzy Spanish Rice Paella
description: A light Andalusian black rice paella with a malty kick, crisp texture, Szechuan peppercorn heat, and a nimono-inspired gentle simmer.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat.
Add black rice and toast until lightly golden and fragrant.
Stir in Szechuan peppercorns and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add tomato puree and smoked paprika, cooking until the mixture coats the rice.
Pour in vegetable broth and add the saffron infusion, stirring to combine.
Bring the liquid to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low and cover the pan.
Simmer the rice for about 25 minutes, checking for tenderness and absorbing liquid.
Fold in sliced shiitake mushrooms and seaweed strips, allowing them to heat through.
Season with soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, and black pepper, mixing well.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the rice and scatter thinly sliced scallions on top.
Remove from heat, let the paella rest for 5 minutes, then serve warm.
Enjoy the jazzy flavor explosion of this low-calorie Andalusian paella.
